items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We all ran over to the table and had to go over and say hello.

ctx.x: I was working with Curtis Amy, Carmell Jones, Frank Butler – ooo, Frank Butler – at the Renaissance, opposite Lenny Bruce. We’re playing. It’s the end – kind of the end of the night. Nobody’s in there. All of a sudden Marilyn Monroe walks in with her entourage, and we’re playing One More Ham Hog Please. Curtis, he just loved to play, and Frank’s playing. Frank is one of these persons, he didn’t miss the scene. Anything happened, he checked it out right away. Curtis too. Eyes would be – first he sees these two…
